reference.scope: Photo references the V2 SKU. The manufacturer's listing for the related V1 SKU with the same CIM-360T model number gives 400 x 385 x 759 mm, used as the nominal standing envelope. Detail dimensions and the compact variant are layout assumptions.

limitations: Stationary open-access presentation with a separate fixed flap and an empty lined bin.
Geometric storage volume is the rectangular clear bin space below the front sill, with no claim about ice packing, mass or manufacturer capacity.
No internal ice production mechanism, refrigeration, electrical/water connections, or installation qualification.
